thread:
maria: Heads-up — customer-site Tango going live next Wed. They want Redwood-managed keys initially, but we need a hardened VPC/onprem plan for egress + KMS traffic. Main asks: RBAC minimal roles for keystore proxy, audit retention for decrypts, and network policy for telemetry. Thoughts? :eyes:

jon: For KMS, do we force traffic to our kms.redwood-api.com region, or support a proxy to their HSM? If proxy, we need strict svcacct scoping and mutual TLS.

maria: They said they'd accept a proxy for HSM, but want RBAC so app teams can't escalate to key creation. So decrypt-only for the proxy service principal.

lisa: Agree. Also note: if we block egress aggressively, our metrics/log shipping breaks. We'll need an explicit allowlist for metrics and healthwebhooks. Suggest two hostnames: `metrics.ingest.redwood.com:443` and `kms.redwood-api.com:443` (or the proxy host).

lisa: Quick netpol suggestion (very small):
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-telemetry-and-kms
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: ["Egress"]
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          purpose: infra
      ports:
      - port: 443
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.10.0.0/16
```

jon: Good start. Also watch conntrack for long-lived KV cache streams — our runtime opens persistent connections for cache streaming. If NAT table evicts them early, you'll see mid-request failures.

darren: Re: RBAC, can we do a scoped role like `keystore:decrypt` + `keystore:status` only? No wildcard perms. Avoid `keystore:full`.

sec-bot: policy-scan ✔️ — Found 2 service roles with wide perms: `infra:admin` and `keystore:full`. Recommendation: split into least-priv roles and enforce MFA on role grant.

maria: @jon can you draft the RBAC changes? Also need audit logging retention: customer requires 1 year for decrypt ops. That affects our storage plan for private deployments.

jon: I'll open a PR with these changes. Draft snippet for role bindings: 
```json
{
  "role": "keystore:decrypt",
  "allowed_actions": ["Decrypt","GetKeyInfo"]
}
```
Link to PR: https://repo/redwood/keystore/pull/231 (draft)

lisa: Ops concern — if we add TLS-only allowlist, remember some onprem networks require IP allowlists rather than hostnames. We should publish both FQDNs and ASN/IP ranges.

maria: Good point. @darren can you run a short perf check with the proxy and with direct Redwood KMS to see connection churn and token exchange frequency?

darren: Yep, I'll run it today and post numbers. Quick note: SDK retry backoff could hit fallback endpoints if DNS fails; recommend client-side pinned endpoints in private deploy config.

ops-bot: Ticket INC-1234 created: "Tango onprem: egress allowlist + RBAC for keystore proxy + audit retention". Assignee: jon.

maria: Next steps: (1) jon PR to scope roles, (2) lisa publish netpol + IP ranges, (3) darren perf run, (4) sec review and sign-off on audit retention storage. If all good, we'll schedule a dry-run cutover Tuesday. :+1:

jon: will do, assigning myself. Expect PR today.

lisa: I can prepare a minimal egress playbook and test namespace tomorrow.

sec-bot: reminder: file a compliance artifact for the retention policy before GA.

maria: thanks all — keep updates in this thread.
